_warning: PRIVATE EVALUATION FILE. Never include this content in agent prompts, stories, regression scenarios or the demo UI. Only server/evaluation reads it, after a run has finished.

bugs.title: Save button stays enabled while a patient is being created
bugs.description: The Create Patient form does not disable the submit button while the request is in flight (~1s server latency) and the backend has no idempotency protection. Double-clicking Save (or pressing Enter twice) creates duplicate patient records.
reproduction: Observe two identical patients in the list / two POST /api/demo/patients 201 responses
bugs.fixedBehavior: The button is disabled and shows 'Saving…' while the request is pending; only one record is created.

bugs.title: Status filter is ignored when a search term is entered
bugs.description: GET /api/demo/patients drops the status condition whenever the search parameter is non-empty, so combining search with a status filter returns patients of every status.
reproduction: Observe Inactive/On Hold/Discharged patients in the results
bugs.fixedBehavior: Search and status filters are combined with AND.

bugs.title: Email format is not validated
bugs.description: Both client and server only check that the email field is non-empty. Values such as 'not-an-email' are accepted and persisted.
reproduction: Enter 'not-an-email' as Email with otherwise valid data
bugs.fixedBehavior: The form shows 'Enter a valid email address.' and the API returns 422.

bugs.title: Therapists can delete patients through the API
bugs.description: The UI only offers Delete to administrators, but DELETE /api/demo/patients/:id does not check the role. A therapist session can delete any patient.
reproduction: Send DELETE /api/demo/patients/{id} with the therapist session
bugs.fixedBehavior: The API returns 403 'Only administrators can delete patients.' for therapists.

bugs.title: Notes entered on creation are not saved
bugs.description: POST /api/demo/patients discards the notes field. Notes appear to be accepted, but are empty on the patient details page and in the API response. Editing an existing patient saves notes correctly.
reproduction: Create a patient with Notes 'Prefers morning sessions'
bugs.fixedBehavior: Notes are persisted on creation and displayed on the details page.
